provenance_note: From a multi-sign interior wayfinding package. All client, vendor, designer, building/level names, street address, and project numbers excluded at extraction. Higher-education vertical retained. Entry copy excluded; copy structure retained.

materials_manifest.product: reverse-printed graphic, white copy on a transparent vinyl background
protective overlaminate vinyl on the back of the applied graphic

dimensions.note: Submitted as full-size art; final field size to be determined to suit the glass lite.

rules_observations: Three-line hierarchy (institution / area / level) gives a clear single primary read on a glass entry.
craft_observations: Second-surface reverse print with a backing protection vinyl puts the ink behind the glass, protecting it and giving a clean first-surface read.
White copy on a translucent field reads against the glazing and the space beyond without a hard opaque panel.

aesthetic_notes.note: Applied-to-glass entry graphic reads as part of the architecture rather than a mounted sign; appropriate for a level/threshold orientation cue.

extraction_meta.field_confidence: high on method and application; size to be determined to suit the glass
extraction_meta.notes: First flat_graphic in this run: validates the v1.1 flat_graphic sibling on a real second-surface vinyl-on-glass case from the Cornell package. No structure/mounting/illumination, as the sibling intends.
